posts.cooked:
The morning's advanced Vengeance games were surprisingly victorious. :) Because I don't mind using spam and cheese in the name of beating something the first time, I think I've come up with a winning strategy, which I would like to share for anyone struggling with Vengeance-style play. (Standard advice of "area-of-effect damage" and "don't use heroes that need to set up" apply.)

1) Setting Sun Ra. You can use normal Ra, because Drawn to the Flame is amazing, but a base power that deals irreducible AoE tears everything apart. And when he finally kicks the bucket, you'll get a lot of mileage per game out of his "destroy all targets with 4 or fewer HP" incap power.

2) Milk the Wasteland. Wait for Con's Bunker and the Ancient Library to come out, then flood the board with environment targets. Until the final rounds of the game, villain targets are likely to be the lowest, so you won't take too much damage. Also synergizes well with Ra if he can get Scorched Earth. Just wait until you start removing villains from the game!

The first game was Redeemer Fanatic, Xtreme Tempest and SS Ra versus Miss Info, Plague Rat and the Operative. Despite those being relatively easy villains, it was the hardest game I played all morning, and Tempest was the only one left standing at the end.

Next, my dream team of Super-Scientific Tachyon, Tempest and SS Ra made milksmeat of La Capitan, Greazer and Sergeant Steel.

The last game was the dream team against La Capitan, Greazer and Bugbear. Bugbear is hard, no lie, but he folded surprisingly easily, mostly thanks to a 9-point Scorched Earth at the end. :D The Capitan/Greazer combo seems to be the way to go if I actually want to beat these. Only two to go!

The Dreamer was defeated in the Enclave by Redeemer Fanatic, PW Haka, Scholar of the Infinite and F6 Wraith.

A rematch with Skinweaver bore fruit! KNYFE went down, but Legacy, Hunted Naturalist, Scholar of the Infinite and Fanatic forged ahead! When you need to win, it's worth filling in fewer cells. :B

On to Mad Bomber Blade in the Enclave! Legacy, KNYFE, Hunted Naturalist and EWAZ were a good team, flipping him just before he hit everyone for 10 damage.

A game with Progeny didn't go so well. Another against the Ennead netted me a victory with Young Legacy, the Adamant Sentinels, Hunted Naturalist, Omnitron-X and the Scholar. But it was literally just the Scholar versus five of the Ennead, and 16 rounds later, he won. >:V

The rematch with Progeny went much better, and the secret was KNYFE. She went down, but she did so much damage. Of course, Legacy, Hunted Naturalist and Ra went down, too, leaving SS Tachyon with one hit point, and she was able to Hypersonic for a couple rounds before finishing him off. It was crazy.

Lastly, the rematch with Spite. I used my tried and true Omnitron/Sky-Scraper method to carry Naturalist and Scholar of the Infinite to victory. :V Fun times, except the complete opposite of that.

And I see we're halfway done now. :D I didn't do that! Go, whoever you are! Get down with your bad self!

I started off with the craziest game ever against Matriarch. Out of GI Bunker, Omnitron-U, PW Fanatic and the Adamant Sentinels, Mainstay was the only hero left alive at the end. She flipped on the environment turn because of Main Computer Room, and then Surprise Shopping Trip came out and literally won me the game. Because she deals less damage on her flip side, every time a bird got played, it was destroyed, over and over and over, and once everyone else was dead, she couldn't touch Mainstay!

Then a fairly easy game against Miss Information, as if such a thing were possible. DR Fixer, Scholar and the Sentinels triumphed in the Final Wasteland.

Omnitron fell to Horus Ra, Omnitron-U, RC Wraith, Absolute Zero and the Sentinels in Pike Industrial. It wasn't that bad a fight, much as I hate Pike Place.

Then a marginally more difficult game against Cosmotron, won handily by KNYFE Rogue Agent, SS Tachyon, Unity, the Adamant Sentinels and Greatest Legacy in Freedom Tower.

The fight with Young Legacy, Nightmist, Scholar of the Infinite and the Adamant Sentinels against Progeny in the Final Wasteland gave me a much stronger appreciation for how the ASents work together.

Had a strangely straightforward game against Wager Master in Wagner Mars Base. EWAZ, Fanatic, Hunted Naturalist, the Adamant Sentinels and Tempest just beat him down.

Lastly, a Vengeance game with Baron Blade, Friction and Proletariat squaring off against the Adamant Sentinels, RC Wraith and KNYFE Rogue Agent in the Enclave. Fun times!
